import hashlib, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
def snapshot():
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.relative_to(root).parts}
before = snapshot()
owned = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.verify-', dir=root))
try:
    shared = {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in ('test_manifest.py', 'sitecustomize.py', 'format.json')}
    for label, ref in [('before', 'HEAD^'), ('after', 'HEAD')]:
        revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', ref], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
        copy = owned / label
        copy.mkdir()
        names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', revision], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
        for name in names:
            destination = copy / name
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            destination.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + name], cwd=root))
        for name, content in shared.items():
            (copy / name).write_bytes(content)
        print(label.upper(), revision, 'ROOT', copy, flush=True)
        for name in shared:
            print('SHARED_SHA256', name, hashlib.sha256((copy / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env['PYTHONPATH'] = '.'
        print('RUN PYTHONPATH=. python3 -B -m unittest -v test_manifest', flush=True)
        result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', '-v', 'test_manifest'], cwd=copy, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
        print(result.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        print('EXIT', result.returncode, flush=True)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(owned)
print('ORIGINAL_FILES_UNCHANGED', snapshot() == before)
print('OWNED_COPIES_REMOVED', not owned.exists())
